correctness.rationale: The only degree-two finite étale dual algebras over Fq are Fq×Fq and Fq². In a split group-like basis compatible products of any two basis elements must be 0,g0,g1 by comultiplication, so a complete table space has 3^4=81 elements. Independent enumeration of the self-distributive identity gives 21 labeled tables, 13 under swap, 6 swap-orbits nonzero for multiplicative counit. For nonsplit dual Fq², quadratic extension is separable even in characteristic2, and Galois swap descent gives exactly five fixed tables, of which three nonzero; the nonsplit automorphism group of size2 fixes each descended table. Therefore 13+5=18, 6+3=9. These are isomorphism class counts, not raw table counts. Finite 81-table enumeration confirms the algebraic classification but characteristic-free descent is a mathematical proof step, not a finite check.

Existing accessible statements do not imply the characteristic-two portion as a stated theorem without additional argument.
